summary: Cape Cod, Massachusetts, web designer, startup founder, strong interest in social media and technology, active in online communities, has two daughters, involved in weather-related startup (OtherWeather.com), critical of mainstream media and corporate practices, skeptical of traditional education, advocates for social influence in news, experienced in online payment processing, views on marijuana use and its effects on productivity, engaged in discussions about political and social issues, prefers practical solutions over theoretical ones.
